total_supply.meaning: ERC-20 totalSupply value used as the scaling factor in minting and redemption formulas

sum_balances.meaning: sum of all account share balances (sum(balanceOf[]))

redemption_assets_released.meaning: assets released to a redeemer for a given number of shares

fair_redemption_assets.meaning: fair pro-rata assets owed per share absent the inflated denominator

assumptions: The redemption formula scales released assets by totalSupply as denominator, so an inflated totalSupply relative to sum_balances reduces assets per share.
No concrete deposit or withdrawal transaction is described; the under-pay is a consequence of the constructor state.
fair_redemption_assets is a symbolic reference quantity for the pro-rata amount; its numeric definition is not given in the report.

unresolved.description: The exact redemption formula and its operands are not given, so the quantitative under-pay relation (released assets vs fair pro-rata assets) cannot be expressed numerically; only the qualitative direction is stated.
No concrete withdrawal execution is described; the under-pay effect is stated as a consequence of the constructor state rather than an observed transaction.

limitations: The claim formalizes only the withdrawal_under_pays impact; the deposit_over_mints and value_skimmed impacts are handled in separate passes.
The relation is qualitative: released assets are required to be at least the fair pro-rata amount, but the fair amount is a symbolic reference without a report-given numeric definition.
The condition encodes the constructor state (totalSupply=1,000,000, sum_balances=0) as the applicability scope; the report does not establish a narrower attacker subcase.
